description: This Java class defines a custom Swing button, PopupMenuButton, that displays a popup menu when clicked and tracks its visibility state. It adds focus, component, and action listeners to handle user interactions with the menu.

classes.name: PopupMenuButton
classes.description: A custom JButton that toggles the visibility of an associated popup menu and tracks its state.

methods.name: PopupMenuButton
methods.description: Constructor initializing the button with a text label and associated popup menu, setting up event listeners to manage focus, component state, and user interaction.
